items.prompt: Use case: game overlay sprite style-transfer. Image 1 is STYLE reference only; DO NOT draw any cat. Image 2 is EDIT TARGET: pair of orange-rimmed pink fish-fin ears on empty1254x1254 canvas. Keep their exact positions and full coverage, left ear roughly x200..480 y65..325, right x625..905 y110..385. Draw ONLY two fin ears, no cat or head or eyes. Convert into bold flat cel shaded sticker shapes: orange outer rims #E98A3C with #B9612B shadow, opaque pink inner membrane #F2A9B4 with 2-3 thick dark-pink #C9645A radial ribs per ear. Distinct scalloped webbed ear silhouette must survive64px downsampling. Thick dark outline #2B2320 about15px. No fur/no translucency/no gradients/no soft lighting. Do not recenter or enlarge to fillcanvas. Solid uniform magenta #FF00FF elsewhere, including all central space. Output1254x1254. Ear bases should cover the full reference footprint to avoid gaps when original ears are erased.
